extension.description: Shows the manual that came with a game, from the game's own folder, and finds one for a game that has none through add-ons that know where manuals are. Pages can be zoomed and panned, and each manual reopens where it was left.
extension.news: v0.2.1 (2026-10-20)[CR]- A PDF or RAR manual offers to install or enable the add-on that reads it, and says it needs PDF or RAR support when that can't be had.[CR]- A manual provider that is disabled is offered for enabling, and Get more... opens from the menu of a game being played.[CR][CR]v0.2.0 (2026-10-13)[CR]- Manual providers are found by an id starting with plugin.game.manuals. instead of a "manuals" entry in what they provide, which Kodi's add-on checker doesn't allow.[CR]- A download is never bigger than the space for downloaded manuals, a search that fails says so, and asking another provider mid-search no longer mixes their answers.[CR]- Names in Japanese and other scripts match their manuals, games with one name no longer share a manual kept in the profile, WebP pages keep their shape, and only the page on screen is kept in the temp folder.[CR][CR]v0.1.2 (2026-10-06)[CR]- A manual beside a game whose name has tags in braces, as PC-8801 sets do, is now found.[CR][CR]v0.1.1 (2026-10-03)[CR]- Sharper pages, a manual already on disk is used before downloading one, and Kodi no longer reports an object left over when the script ends.[CR][CR]v0.1.0 (2026-10-02)[CR]- First release: shows a game's manual, and finds one through manual providers.
